description: This file defines an extension for the CronSettings class, adding helper methods for UI presentation such as selecting jobs, formatting statuses and schedules, and generating labels for upcoming runs.

classes.name: CronSettings
classes.description: The class extended here, representing configuration/settings related to cron jobs.

methods.name: selectedJob
methods.description: Returns the currently selected CronJob based on the selectedJobId stored in CronSettings.

methods.name: statusTint
methods.description: Determines a color tint based on the status string, used for UI coloring.

methods.name: scheduleSummary
methods.description: Provides a human-readable summary string for a given CronSchedule.

methods.name: formatDuration
methods.description: Formats a duration in milliseconds into a concise string representation.

methods.name: nextRunLabel
methods.description: Generates a label indicating how soon the next scheduled run is, relative to now.
